purpose: Track which related-work and reviewer-critical baselines have executable evidence in this repository.

items.claim_boundary: Useful sanity baseline only; beating random does not prove method novelty.

items.description: Structural category or small-first allocation heuristics.
items.claim_boundary: Heuristic ablation, not an external SOTA comparator.

items.description: Consensus allocation compared with budget-matched random seeds on WikiText2/C4 slices.
WikiText2-vs-C4 sensitivity ranking instability across public small model families.
items.claim_boundary: Defines the measured problem setting; not a quality-retention proof by itself.

items.description: Minimal AutoAWQ package execution smoke that produces local quantized artifacts under GPU guard.
items.claim_boundary: Readiness probe only: it may show that AutoAWQ can run locally, but it is not a matched AWQ baseline or quality-retention comparison.

items.description: Minimal matched FP16-vs-AutoAWQ PPL comparisons on the same prompt slices, including tiny public WikiText2/C4 slices.
items.claim_boundary: Readiness PPL probe only: it may show same-prompt FP16-vs-AutoAWQ comparisons, but it is not a full public-dataset AWQ/GPTQ baseline.

items.description: Public-calibration AutoAWQ W4 group-128 bundle with guarded quantization and tiny public WikiText2/C4 matched PPL eval slices.
items.claim_boundary: Partial official-package readiness: it uses public calibration and public eval slices, but it is still one AutoAWQ tiny-slice bundle, not a matched AWQ/GPTQ competitive baseline.

items.description: Public-calibration GPTQModel W4 group-128 smoke with guarded quantization, saved local artifact, reload through a conservative torch backend, and a tiny public WikiText2 matched PPL diagnostic.
items.claim_boundary: Partial official-package readiness: it proves GPTQModel can quantize, save, reload, and evaluate a tiny public slice locally, but it is not a full GPTQ/AWQ competitive baseline or task-retention result.

items.description: Faithful official AWQ/GPTQ-family PTQ baseline under matched calibration, budget, and evaluation.
items.claim_boundary: Smoke and proxy artifacts are useful readiness diagnostics, but they do not cover faithful official AWQ/GPTQ baseline claims without matched calibration, budget, PPL, and task comparisons.

items.description: Faithful rotation/outlier mitigation baseline family such as QuaRot or SpinQuant.
items.claim_boundary: Current rotation-family proxy artifacts are useful related-family diagnostics, but they do not cover faithful QuaRot/SpinQuant implementation or activation/KV quality claims.

items.description: Faithful recent mixed-precision allocation comparator such as Q-Palette, IMPQ, or WINDQuant.
items.claim_boundary: Current Q-Palette-style proxy artifacts are useful related-family diagnostics, but they do not cover faithful Q-Palette/IMPQ/WINDQuant reproduction claims.

items.description: Tiny real public-task schema smoke covering GSM8K and MMLU ingestion.
items.claim_boundary: Proves public-schema task ingestion and guarded execution only; not leaderboard-scale retention.

items.description: Task retention beyond PPL, for example MMLU/GSM8K/IFEval/HumanEval/BBH subsets.
items.claim_boundary: A guarded 100-row public MMLU/GSM8K subset is covered; leaderboard-scale retention and fused-model public quality remain missing.

items.description: Measured packed INT4/INT8 kernel evidence on Qwen-like Linear shapes.
items.claim_boundary: Kernel-level evidence only; not end-to-end LLM acceleration.

items.description: On-device Redmi K80 Pro TTFT, tokens/s, peak memory, and thermal or power logs.
items.claim_boundary: No mobile deployment claim until real device logs exist.
